teaser: You slide a card across the hotel lobby desk before the clerk finishes typing, already reading the total upside down. That is life path 8 crossed with an INTP's instinct to verify before it trusts. The 8 wants command of the material world — money, authority, the room itself. The INTP wants the mechanism under the room: why the system works, not just that it does. Crossed, you get someone who builds leverage out of understanding rather than charm, who would rather be right about the structure than liked for running it.
excerpt: Three shirts come off the hanger before you try a fourth, each one weighed against a standard only you can see, and that same quiet calculation follows you into love.
